DocMind Privacy Policy
Last Updated: August 1, 2026

1. Data Collection
When you use DocMind's RAG and embedding services, we collect:
- Document uploads (PDFs, TXT, DOCX) processed through our pipelines
- API usage telemetry (latency, request counts)
- Account information (name, email, billing details)

2. Data Usage and LLM Training
DocMind strictly separates customer data. Your uploaded documents and vector embeddings are stored in isolated ChromaDB namespaces. 
IMPORTANT: DocMind does NOT use customer documents or user-submitted queries to train our foundational models (like DocMind-Mini or DocMind-Pro). Your data remains yours.

3. Data Retention
By default, documents are retained for the active life of your account. If you delete a document from your dashboard, the raw file and its corresponding vector embeddings are hard-deleted within 72 hours.
If an account is cancelled, all associated data is wiped after 30 days.

4. Third-Party Subprocessors
We use the following subprocessors:
- AWS (Hosting & Storage)
- Stripe (Payment Processing)
- Together AI (Optional Fallback LLM API)

DocMind Service Level Agreement (SLA)
Effective Date: March 15, 2026

1. Service Commitment
DocMind commits to providing a 99.9% uptime for our Enterprise and Pro tier customers. Uptime is measured monthly, excluding scheduled maintenance.

2. Scheduled Maintenance
Scheduled maintenance will occur during low-traffic windows (typically Saturday 2:00 AM - 4:00 AM UTC). Customers will be notified at least 48 hours in advance via the status page.

3. Service Credits
If DocMind fails to meet the 99.9% uptime commitment in a billing month, eligible customers may request a Service Credit:
- 99.0% to 99.89%: 10%

To claim a credit, customers must submit a support ticket within 30 days of the incident. Credits cannot be exchanged for cash and will be applied to future invoices.
